# Bulk-01 notes

## Ledger review pass 1.1

The observed failure ledger for bulk-01 records 2 faults against the reader, each
one reproduced by running the command rather than by reading the code. A ledger entry
that names no test is not a record of a fix, it is a record of an intention, and the
gate treats the two differently. Every failure listed below was observed in a real run
and every one of them is now covered by a test that fails against the unfixed reader.
The remaining risk is not in the ledger at all but in the files it points at.
